=== order-guess-functions-bucket-collision
--- main
!function $f($a, $b)
!return $a + "-" + $b
!endfunction
!function $g($x)
!return "[" + $x + "]"
!endfunction
!$v = $f(1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + $g(1), 2)
A : $v

=== order-overload-zero-args-h
--- main
!function $h($a="1")
!return "one"
!endfunction
!function $h($a="1", $b="2")
!return "two"
!endfunction
!function $h($a="1", $b="2", $c="3")
!return "three"
!endfunction
A : $h()

=== order-overload-named
--- main
!function $q($a, $z="z1")
!return "q2"
!endfunction
!function $q($a, $y="y", $z="z2")
!return "q3"
!endfunction
A : $q(1, $z="Z")
=== order-overload-many-names
--- main
!function $alpha($a="1")
!return "alpha1"
!endfunction

!return "alpha2"
!endfunction
!function $beta($a="1")
!return "beta1"
!endfunction

!return "beta2"
!endfunction
!function $gamma($a="1", $b="2")
!return "gamma2"
!endfunction
!function $gamma($a="1", $b="2", $c="3", $d="4")
!return "gamma4"
!endfunction
!function $x1($a="1")
!return "x1-1"
!endfunction
!function $x1($a="1", $b="2", $c="3")
!return "x1-3"
!endfunction
A : $alpha() $beta() $gamma() $gamma(1) $x1()
